Bug_Title: DMI: Invocation of hashCode on an array (DMI_INVOKING_HASHCODE_ON_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes hashCode on an array. Calling hashCode on
an array returns the same value as System.identityHashCode, and ignores
the contents and length of the array. If you need a hashCode that
depends on the contents of an array a,
use java.util.Arrays.hashCode(a).

 a java.util.Arrays.hashCode(a)
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by invoking the hashCode method directly on an array. This invocation returns the identity hash code of the array, which does not consider the contents or length of the array. The correct approach would be to use Arrays.hashCode(array).
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with different arrays that have the same contents (array1 and array2) and different contents (array1 and array3). Since the hashCode method on arrays does not consider the contents, the assertions will fail, demonstrating the bug.
